vehicleDetails.title: Harrier EV
vehicleDetails.description:
The Tata Harrier EV is generating buzz as Tata Motors gears up to launch its first electric SUV with an all-wheel-drive (AWD) configuration. With its sleek design and advanced powertrain, this upcoming electric SUV is poised to set new benchmarks in the Indian EV market.

Unmatched Range and Performance

One of the most talked-about features of the Tata Harrier EV is its claimed range of 500 km on a single charge. Although detailed specifications are still under wraps, early reports reveal that the Harrier EV will be available in two variants – Medium Range and Long Range – ensuring that there’s an option for every kind of driver.

  • Top Speed: Yet to be revealed
  • Range: 500 km
  • Acceleration (0-40 km/h): Yet to be revealed
  • Acceleration (0-60 km/h): Yet to be revealed

Advanced Powertrain and Electric Technology

Tata Motors is taking a bold step by adapting its renowned Harrier platform to electric mobility. Here’s what we know so far about the powertrain and design:

  • Motor Type: The Harrier EV boasts a two-motor setup – one on each axle – providing a robust AWD performance.
  • Transmission: It comes with an automatic transmission, ensuring a smooth and efficient driving experience.
  • Seating Capacity: Designed as a 5-seater SUV, the Harrier EV combines practicality with futuristic electric technology.

While details on motor power, battery capacity, and charging specifications (fast charging and home charging times) have not yet been disclosed, the Harrier EV is expected to impress with its performance and modern technology.

Sleek Design Meets Practicality

Maintaining the legacy of its ICE counterpart, the Tata Harrier EV retains the aggressive and modern styling of the original Harrier. The design enhancements include:

  • A revamped front grille inspired by the Curvv Concept.
  • Characteristic LED headlamps and taillamps that elevate its premium appeal.
  • A spacious and comfortable cabin equipped with advanced infotainment and connectivity features.

These design elements are not just about aesthetics—they also enhance the overall driving experience, making the Harrier EV a perfect blend of style and substance.

Anticipated Launch and Pricing

Set to launch in March 2025, the Tata Harrier EV is expected to be priced in the range of Rs. 24.00 - 28.00 Lakh (ex-showroom). With Tata Motors building on its reputation for quality and innovation, the Harrier EV is likely to be a strong contender in the competitive electric SUV segment.

What’s Next?

As Tata Motors finalizes the details, potential buyers and automotive enthusiasts eagerly await more information on specifications such as:

  • Fast Charging Time & Home Charging Time
  • Detailed motor power figures (Nominal/Peak)
  • Advanced battery specifications and dimensions
  • Comprehensive safety and driver-assistance features

Stay tuned for more updates as Tata Motors prepares to unveil the complete specifications of the Harrier EV. With a promising blend of performance, design, and technology, the Tata Harrier EV is set to redefine the electric SUV landscape in India.
